flags: FHWA gives 31 miles; catalog mapping gives 44.2. Omitted mileage.
Cache does not document construction or designation date. History is limited to the endpoint railway settlement and documented land management.
Pine Dunes is tied to the byway but its turnoff/order is not established; retained only in the attributed overview. Moments follow Ravendale-to-Duck Flat order, reversing BLM’s description.
Short moments reflect thin site evidence. 2022 gather plans are historical, not current herd counts or access restrictions. No current story exists.
